LiveSupport Web UI — third-party notices
=======================================

The browser libraries are committed byte-for-byte from the versioned URLs below.
SHA-256 pins are maintained in tools/vendor_web_assets.py; SOURCES.txt preserves
SHA-384 provenance from their original acquisition. Normal builds are offline.

Python dependencies
-------------------
The release's third_party_licenses directory contains the original installed
license/notice files for pywebview (BSD-3-Clause), pythonnet (MIT), clr_loader
(MIT), bottle (MIT), typing_extensions (PSF-2.0), cffi (MIT), pycparser (BSD),
and all other resolved desktop/build dependencies. Their exact versions and
hashes of copied texts are recorded in build-info.json by tools/build_manifest.py.
The consolidated notices here cover proxy_tools and bundled libraries whose
license files are omitted from their wheels.
